hook: Hauling a bag bigger than you are.
setting: On the fairway, short grass and open hole behind, camera facing both babies.
action: Mulligan shoulders a towering golf bag, wobbles, then topples sideways and disappears under it. Birdie leans over the heap.
sound: clattering clubs, a soft thud, birdsong
judge: Carry reversal is cute but very predictable.
